# `team.member.add`

Add a team member

Session-only, organization owners. Membership implies organization membership and sends a notice.

- Method and path: `POST /{org}/-/teams/{team}/members`
- Scope: `repo:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie team member add`
- MCP: `team_member_add`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | body | no | `string` |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `org` | path | yes | `string` |
| `team` | path | yes | `string` |
| `user` | body | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `not-found`, `unauthorized`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
